worldcombat.skill.zapcannon.summary: Charge the barrel, then fire a slow, heavy electric shell. It flies slowly and only steers a little, so a sideways move escapes it; but any hit hits hard and always paralyses the target. The charge can be interrupted and costs nothing. Electric types are immune to paralysis.
Fill the barrel and fire a shell at %1$s power, travelling at %2$s blocks per tick out to %3$s; it is far slower than the family's bolts, which is why it is hard to land.
After %1$s of charging the shell hits and always paralyses the target for %2$s; electric types are immune.
The shell corrects %1$s degrees per tick and the recoil pushes the caster back %2$s blocks; cooldown %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.zapcannon.quickload.on: Quickload: charge x0.6, shell speed x1.3, turn x1.35 and cooldown x0.9 to land it through a strafe, at the cost of x0.78 power and x0.85 paralysis.
worldcombat.skill.zapcannon.quickload.of: Full load: a longer charge, a heavier and slower shell and a longer paralysis, at the cost of standing still to charge and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.zapcannon.timing: Range %1$s, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.zapcannon.growth.0: From level %1$s the shell power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.zapcannon.use.1: Pin whatever is charging in, before it arrives
worldcombat.skill.zapcannon.use.2: Break the foe's rhythm with one shot
worldcombat.skill.zapcannon.preference.q: On: charge x0.6, shell speed x1.3, turn x1.35 and cooldown x0.9 to land it through a strafe, but x0.78 power and x0.85 paralysis. Off: full load, a longer charge and a heavier, slower, longer-lasting shell.
worldcombat.skill.zapcannon.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in instead of firing; larger values open from further away.
When on, a target moving fast gets top priority so one shot pins it; when off, all threats rank the same.
When on, targets beyond 60 percent of the range get priority, since the long charge is safer at distance; when off, it fires as soon as the target is in range.
world_combat.move.zapcannon.text.immune: Electric typing shrugged off the paralysis
